summary: Nix research program phase 6 after a dive wave: one opus agent harvests the new consolidations, appends the landing report to the topic map, applies the stop condition, and commissions the next wave (revised staged briefs plus follow-ups) or declares ready-to-draft with binding authoring notes
logs: Verdict: needs-another-round · rerun 2 · next wave 6 · IDs 52 · MUST 36 · families 3 · contradictions 9

harvest.verdict_reason: Wave 2 added 36 new MUST rules and two new failure classes: C3, where a warm store masks a cold failure, and C7, misattributed diagnostics. It opened only 3 of 9 families; NIX-INP, NIX-PKG, NIX-REL, NIX-LANG, NIX-SEC and NIX-MOD have no consolidation. Load-bearing questions a fixture run can still answer: the builders' cold-safe spellings and pkgs.system blind spot, which gate the ocx and grim flakes; M-E-11 env translation and 1,293-version scale, which gate the ocx handoff; and follows and lock policy. By the wave-plan stop condition the program has not converged.

frame_corrections: H1, corrected again: the 56 'system has been renamed' warnings do not trace to import nixpkgs { inherit system; }. A minimal import emits zero; the trigger is reading pkgs.system (pkgs/top-level/aliases.nix:2498; NIX-FLK-12; nix-flakes.md conflict 2). Both the frame's wave-1 correction (line 176) and map point 9 are wrong on this point. nix-installer's actual source is still open (packaging/fleet-builders).
H1 '1000 instances': no warning or error was measured at fixture scale, so it is demoted to SHOULD (NIX-FLK-11).

H6 settled: plain nixpkgs fetchurl with 'Authorization: Bearer QQ==' fetches any public ghcr.io blob in the sandbox, and the twin without the header gets 401. hash is the layer digest verbatim, not converted to SRI, because Lix 2.95.2 lacks builtins.convertHash (NIX-GEN-08, NIX-GEN-09).
H7 refined: a bare offer is not guaranteed static, because libc tagging drifts. autoPatchelfHook is a measured no-op on a static ELF, so every Linux package gets it (NIX-GEN-11).

H9 sharpened: the Lix leg caught one real divergence (a rec/non-rec merge, nix-gates.md V19), while floats without a leading zero only warn. Lix flakes are frozen and moving into a plugin. The non-stub floor set in 26.11pre is nix_2_31, nix_2_34 and nix_2_35; nix_2_30 throws too (V20).

New: nix flake check --no-build depends on store state. It passes an IFD flake on a warm store and fails it on a cold one (V13). The same holds for eval-time reads through the flake's own source store path (NIX-FLK-07) and for FOD transport changes made without --rebuild (nix-generated-flakes.md failure mode 2).
New: nix flake check does not shape-check nixosModules; it only forces the value (NIX-FLK-06). A literal duplicate attribute is already a hard eval error (V10).

ocx data: 96 of 122 index basenames exist in nixpkgs pkgs/by-name, and 101 of 122 once the legacy tree is counted; the map named only cmake, ninja and node. Every digest on every platform comes to about 2.1 MiB. 231 of 1,720 license annotations are SPDX expressions. p/ocx/cli and p/grimoire/cli have no license annotation.

Era: nixfmt-classic throws on 26.11pre (converted 2026-07-01), and nixfmt-rfc-style is a warnAlias. The nixfmt 1.5.0 directory mode is deprecated but still works. nixpkgs builds statix from the molybdenumsoftware fork. nixf-diagnose 0.1.4 is in 26.11pre. install-nix-action v31.11.1 hardcodes Nix 2.35.2. cache-nix-action is at v7.

Measurement environment: the 'store contention' reported in waves 1 and 2 was a stale SQLite dotfile lock, plus nix-portable's launcher forcing WAL off. run.sh now enters the store through bwrap with WAL on, and ten parallel builds succeed. This supersedes the frame's last correction and map M1: dives no longer serialize, and a hang is an environment fault to report.
contradictions_across_consolidations: E1 NIX-FLK-07 vs NIX-GATE-09 triage row and nix-gates.md Verdict 5. The gates file calls 'path …-source is not valid' a checker limit, fixed by running from the checkout. The flakes consolidation's twins show a read through the source store path fails even from the local checkout on a cold store, on 2.35.2 and 2.31.5, while the alias is always green. Resolution: it is an author defect. NIX-FLK-07 keeps the text; the GATE-09 row cites FLK-07 with 'author's fix: read the source-tree path'; the 'checker limit' label applies only to IFD (GATE-08). The map's 'Explicitly not a defect' bullet 2 is withdrawn.

E2 NIX-FLK-02 vs map conflict 4 and the NIX-GEN overlay spelling. 'final: prev:' with an unused prev fails the NIX-GATE-05 deadnix gate. NIX-FLK-02 ('final: _prev:') keeps the text; NIX-GEN-07 cites it, and the generator emits final: _prev:.

E3 NIX-FLK-17 vs NIX-GATE-01 overlap on the formatter. FLK-17 keeps 'expose formatter and checks' (SHOULD, shapes A/D/E). GATE-01 keeps the formatter package (nixfmt-tree, MUST once one is declared). The fleet-wide 'MUST declare' is a project commitment that belongs in the adopt skill.

E4 NIX-GATE-10 (build every package, MUST for A and D) vs NIX-GEN-15 (smoke-build the changed packages). For shape D, NIX-GEN-15 keeps the text: build and run every package whose data changed on the update PR. GATE-10 applies to A as written and gains a one-line D clause citing GEN-15.

E5 NIX-GATE-15 (an Apple-silicon runner when aarch64-darwin is declared) vs the NIX-GEN default of evaluating aarch64-darwin without building it. GATE-15 is a SHOULD and keeps the text; the D depth file records the stated reason (M-E-10 is untested).

E6 NIX-FLK-15 (MUST hardcode mainProgram for every runnable package; the generator 'must derive and verify one') vs NIX-GEN-13 (set it only when there is exactly one binary; never guess). kitware/cmake ships 5 peer binaries. NIX-GEN-13 keeps the D text. NIX-FLK-15 keeps the A text plus an exception clause for multi-binary prebuilt packages. The Applied note 'derive and verify one' is superseded.

E7 NIX-FLK-13 (one package.nix, drvPath equality through .extend overlays.default) vs NIX-GEN-07 (the overlay adds only ocx). D satisfies FLK-13 through one shared builder called once per data entry. Its equality check compares packages.SYS.NS-PKG with (extend overlay).ocx.NS.PKG. FLK-13 keeps the rule, and the D depth file states the D attribute path.

E8 nix-gates.md gate-block step 4 (Q5 with allow-import-from-derivation false) vs NIX-FLK Check 1 (nix flake check --no-build --no-write-lock-file .): the same check stated twice. The gate block is canonical and lives in the index; the FLK rows cite 'gate step 4'.
E9 map Q7, Q18 and Q20 vs NIX-GEN-13, 09 and 07. The GEN rules win and those map checks are retired. Q6 is replaced by NIX-FLK-16's git ls-files, and Q4 by NIX-FLK-12's --all-systems warning count.
